strings.title: A Groom Without a Trace
strings.hint: Who wrote the bride's message that the bride never wrote? The cell tower has no favorites.
strings.solvedText:
Culprit: best man Wissam Deeb — his lifelong friend.

Crushing gambling debts were due the next morning. He messaged the groom from a new number, signing as 'Your bride': 'Meet me behind the hall now — something about our wedding night.' There he drugged him, took the bridal jewelry bag, and tied him up in the venue's old storeroom. He intended to 'discover' him himself the next morning and become the heroic rescuer.

The groom was rescued unharmed, and the wedding took place two weeks later. What convicted the best man: cell-tower evidence linking the message number to him, storeroom keys held only by him and the venue coordinator, and gambling club chips in his car.
strings.summary.text: An hour before the wedding procession, groom Youssef Hamdan vanished from the wedding hall with the bridal jewelry he was to present before both families. His phone was off, his car still parked, and his wedding suit hanging in his room. Whispers in the hall were divided between 'He ran away' and 'He was kidnapped,' while the bride clutched his last message: 'Back in a few minutes — do not worry.'

strings.scene.address: Al-Yasmin Wedding Hall — rear courtyard and old storeroom
strings.scene.intro: Behind the hall: a short drag trail toward the old storeroom door, and a premium cigarette butt of a brand the workers do not smoke. The jewelry bag disappeared. The groom's phone was found switched off in a nearby bin — whoever turned it off knew phones can be tracked.

strings.evidence[0].title: The 'Your Bride' Message
strings.evidence[0].desc: 'Meet me behind the hall now' — from a SIM bought with cash on the wedding morning.
strings.evidence[1].title: Cell-Tower Data
strings.evidence[1].desc: The message number's signal originated inside the hall itself at the moment of sending.
strings.evidence[2].title: Storeroom Keys
strings.evidence[2].desc: An unregistered second set. He said he 'happened to still have them from the morning preparations.'
strings.evidence[3].title: Gambling Club Chips
strings.evidence[3].found: The best man's car glove compartment
strings.evidence[3].desc: High-value chips and a debt receipt due the following morning.
strings.evidence[4].title: Premium Cigarette Butt
strings.evidence[4].desc: A rare brand — matching the cigarette pack in the best man's pocket.
strings.evidence[5].title: Business Partner Dispute
strings.evidence[5].desc: His partner demands payment before he 'ties the knot' — an early lead.
strings.suspects[0].name: Partner Mazen Quwatli
strings.suspects[0].alibi: 'I arrived late, at eight. My invitation was stamped with my entry time.'
strings.suspects[0].statement: I asked for what I was owed before his marriage because married men's priorities change. That is an argument between partners, not a crime. I arrived after he vanished. Ask at the entrance.
strings.suspects[1].name: Best man Wissam Deeb
strings.suspects[1].alibi: 'I left him resting in his room and went to check on the procession and band.'
strings.suspects[1].statement: Youssef is my brother before he is my friend. I organized every detail of this day. I had the keys from the morning preparations, and half the hall smokes those cigarettes. Look for his partner, the one who threatened to sue him.
strings.suspects[2].name: The bride's father
strings.suspects[2].alibi: 'I was greeting guests at the entrance in front of two hundred witnesses.'
strings.suspects[2].statement: I never liked the match and said so privately. But my daughter loved him, so I stayed quiet and paid for half the wedding. Who kidnaps his son-in-law on the night he is personally receiving the guests?
strings.witnesses[0].name: Venue coordinator
strings.witnesses[0].statement: I gave the best man a set of keys that morning 'to bring in the decorations.' When I asked for them that afternoon, he said he had returned them to my office. I could not find them.
strings.witnesses[1].name: Buffet worker
strings.witnesses[1].statement: I saw the best man smoking behind the hall around seven, speaking quietly on the phone. Then he disappeared for ten minutes.
strings.witnesses[2].name: The bride
strings.witnesses[2].statement: I sent nothing. I was with the beautician, and my sister had my phone. Whoever signed my name knew Youssef would never refuse me.

strings.folders[0].docs[0].body: Urgent report of a groom disappearing before his wedding procession with the bridal jewelry.
strings.folders[1].name: Forensic evidence
strings.folders[1].docs[0].title: Rear Courtyard Report
strings.folders[1].docs[0].body: A short trail toward the storeroom made by a partly conscious person: dragging steps rather than a body being fully dragged.
strings.folders[1].docs[1].title: SIM Card Report
strings.folders[1].docs[1].body: The message SIM was sold for cash on the wedding morning at a kiosk near the best man's home. The vendor said the photograph 'probably' showed the buyer.
strings.folders[2].name: Interviews
strings.folders[2].docs[0].title: Partner Interview
strings.folders[2].docs[0].body: Venue entrance records confirm his arrival at 19:58 — after the disappearance.
strings.folders[2].docs[1].title: Best Man Interview
strings.folders[2].docs[1].body: Contradictions in his route while 'checking arrangements.' Ten minutes without witnesses match the disappearance window.
strings.folders[2].docs[2].title: Bride's Father Interview
strings.folders[2].docs[2].body: Documented at the reception entrance throughout the relevant time window.
strings.folders[3].name: Records
strings.folders[3].docs[0].title: Club Debt Record
strings.folders[3].docs[0].body: A large gambling debt owed by Wissam Deeb, due the morning after the wedding, accompanied by a threat of 'special collection.'
strings.folders[3].docs[1].title: Rear Street Camera Record
strings.folders[3].docs[1].body: No car left the rear courtyard. The jewelry never left the venue: it was hidden for quiet removal later.
strings.folders[4].name: Confidential files
strings.folders[4].docs[0].title: Storeroom Opening Record
strings.folders[4].docs[0].body: The groom was found tied up with peculiar gentleness: a pillow under his head and water beside him. A kidnapper who provides for his victim knows him. The jewelry bag was behind the decoration barrels.
strings.folders[4].docs[1].title: Best Man's Confession
strings.folders[4].docs[1].body: 'I was going to bring him back myself in the morning and become the hero... I only needed the gold for one night.' He broke into tears before finishing.
strings.reports[0].title: Time Window Report
strings.reports[0].author: Investigation team
strings.reports[0].body: The message was sent from inside the hall. The disappearance occurred during ten unwitnessed minutes belonging to only one person in the circle.
strings.reports[1].title: The Gentle Kidnapper Report
strings.reports[1].author: Assigned investigator
strings.reports[1].body: The restraints, pillow, and water suggest a kidnapper who cares for his victim. A crime driven by need rather than hatred, which does not lessen its legal classification.
strings.notes[0].text: The bride did not send it — who knows he cannot refuse her?
strings.notes[1].text: The jewelry never left — the culprit will return for it
